text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—They've turned into the final straight!! 
What will happen from here on out?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (Win! Right here, I will――)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Not if I can help it—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Heeeeeeyaaaaaaaahhh!!!

She broke clear, she broke clear!! Wonder 
Acute has broken through!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And they cross the finish line!! The one 
who has claimed the new throne is Wonder 
Acute!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Wonder Acute...! She really 
showed off her veteran grit...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae was so close...! But man, 
that was an incredibly thrilling race!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“—That was close, Tarumae. But this has 
made me certain.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The key to my future is Tarumae...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I'm to challenge the two of them, 
when...? The gap is still huge... The JBC 
Classic...? No, even further down the 
line—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Let's set our sights on "that." 
If we set it as our goal ahead of time, 
I'm sure we'll make it in time...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae...! Acute-san...! I'll definitely 
make it there, so just wait for me...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ngh— Uuuuugggh...!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I didn't reach them...!! I was so close, 
too...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Was Hokko Tarumae always the type to 
get this frustrated...? It's kind of 
surprising.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, somehow... She gives off a 
different vibe than usual, and it's kinda 
cool—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute-san! Congratulations...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It is my complete defeat...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was only able to run like that today 
because Tarumae-chan fired me up so much!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You've truly grown strong in both body and 
mind—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...The 'JBC Classic.' That's where I'm 
planning to race next.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting for your rematch.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I will definitely come challenge you 
again...! At the JBC Classic, once more!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I got carried away and declared it, but 
I'm really running the JBC Classic next, 
right!?
choice_data_list: It's okay, I do intend to run

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Whew... Thank goodness.

The "historic record" meant to be 
presented to Smart Falcon in order to draw 
her out—

In aiming for 'Most GⅠ Wins in History,' 
which was one of them, the JBC Classic was 
also a race where she wanted to deliver 
results.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was frustrated that I lost today, but 
something happy happened too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san told me straight to my face that 
she's waiting for a rematch...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That Acute-san actually considers me her 
rival—

...To Hokko Tarumae, Wonder Acute had 
always been a great senior leading the 
way.

I used to be overwhelmed by her running, 
but now I can stand shoulder to shoulder 
and compete with her. That fact fills me 
with pride—

Setting her sights on the JBC Classic as 
her next battle, she springs into 
action...!
